notes:
POC summary: Caldera wanted to consolidate multiple inference endpoints into a single runtime. Primary drivers: better structured outputs for downstream orchestration, reliable tool-calling (external API triggers), and dense embeddings for reranking. POC design: three workloads — 1) agent-style support flow with tool calls (order lookup, ticket creation), 2) embeddings + reranker for knowledge search, 3) structured invoice parsing. Redwood delivered stable latency (~220ms median) and cost estimates in line with expectations, but QA found recurring quality regressions vs incumbent in the tool-calling scenario — two classes observed:
- malformed JSON/tool payloads on edge cases (dates/timezones) leading to orchestration failures
- hallucinated parameter values when external context was trimmed (prefix caching edge case)
Caldera quote from review call: "We can't ship something that silently fails our downstream pipelines — 99.8% correctness for tool payloads is non-negotiable."
Security: baseline ok but compliance timeline mismatch. Caldera's security team flagged the private deployment roadmap — they need KMS integration, audit log retention settings, and residency proof before procurement. SE notes: Rohit implemented structured output schema enforcement during POC but regression persisted on longer contexts; suspected tokenization/special-char handling differences between Redwood model variant and incumbent.
Commercials: pricing was competitive but not decisive; biggest decider was perceived quality delta in production scenarios. Account motion: stalled -> unresponsive exec sponsor after budget freeze. No active champion in product org to continue momentum.
Suggested follow-ups: keep watch on competitor issues (Slack channels + public incidents), monthly beat cadence to CISO + head of ML for 3 months, propose narrow pilot for structured output with stricter validation + golden prompt set if re-opened.
summary_requirements: Must support robust tool-calling with 99.8% structured payload correctness, KMS-backed key management, VPC/private control plane, per-route latency <250ms p50 for agent flows, scalable embeddings for 100M docs reranking, audit logs retention 13+ months
winback_plan: Monitor incumbent regression signals; propose targeted structured-output pilot (2-week) and hold security workshop; re-engage if competitor problems observed; check budget in Q4
